## Referenced types

### CoderTemplateVersionJob

CoderTemplateVersionJob summarizes the import job of a template version.
The job error text is not exposed: Terraform output can contain secrets.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | Status is the Coder provisioner job status, for example succeeded or failed. |
| `errorCode` | string | ErrorCode is the Coder job error code, if the job failed with one. |
